spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (स्तेनयति)
To steal, to rob.

m. (-नः)
1 A thief.
2 Thieving, stealing.
E.
स्तेन to steal, aff. अच.

m. (-मः)
Wetness, moisture.
E.
ष्टिम to be wet, aff. घञ्.

n. (-यं)
Theft, robbery.
E.
स्तेन to steal, यत् aff., the final न rejected.

m. (-यी)
1 A goldsmith.
2 A thief.
E.
स्तेय theft, इनि aff.
